title: Quiet rest before blood pressure recheck
summary: Five-minute CDC settling routine before taking or repeating a blood pressure measurement.

steps.text: Avoid food, caffeine and heavy exercise for 30 minutes beforehand.
Empty your bladder before fitting the cuff.
Anchor yourself with legs uncrossed and back supported for 5 minutes.
steps.detail: Microgravity adaptation of CDC seated rest steps.

steps.text: Place the cuff on your bare upper arm at heart level and stay silent.
